data.long_meaning: Goddess of wisdom, learning, and prosperity, embodiment of the god Sharva. The name Sharvameen carries the meaning “Goddess Sharva” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit. Parents who choose Sharvameen usually hope their child will grow to embody goddess sharva and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the power of knowledge and wisdom, encourages the pursuit of spiritual growth
data.etymology: Sharvameen belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Goddess Sharva.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Sharvameen total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.
